title: Ence size
body:
# ence-size

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/ence-size?style=for-the-badge&color=248046)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ence-size)
[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ence-size)
[![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-orange?style=for-the-badge)](https://fabricmc.net/)

**ence-size** is a premium, client-side Minecraft mod designed to let you adjust your in-game aspect ratio on the fly. Whether you want to preview how your build looks in ultra-widescreen, simulate cinematic camera setups, or play with custom stretched resolutions, **ence-size** handles it all with a gorgeous UI and fluid animations.

---

## ✨ Features

*   **Real-time Aspect Ratio Adjustments:** Control your aspect ratio dynamically using a precise slider.
*   **Aesthetic UI Panel:** A sleek, glassmorphic dark-themed control panel that glides in from the right edge of the screen.
*   **One-Click Presets:** Instantly switch between common aspect ratios:
    *   `21:9` (Ultrawide cinematic view)
    *   `16:9` (Standard widescreen)
    *   `4:3` (Retro/stretched view)
    *   `1.00` (Perfect square)
*   **Smooth Motion & Transitions:** Features dynamic cubic-out animations for a premium, responsive feel when changing ratios or opening/closing the UI.
*   **Highly Optimized & Server-Safe:** Works entirely client-side. Safe to use on any multiplayer server!

---

## 🎮 How to Use

1.  Press **`Right Shift`** (default keybinding) while in-game to open the **ence-size** adjustment panel.
2.  Drag the vertical slider up or down to set a custom aspect ratio.
3.  Click on any of the preset buttons (`21:9`, `16:9`, etc.) to snap instantly to that ratio.
4.  Click anywhere outside the panel or press **`ESC`** / **`Right Shift`** to close it.
5.  *(Optional)* Customize the keybinding in Minecraft's standard controls menu under **Key Binds > ence-size**.

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1.  Make sure you have [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) installed for Minecraft **1.21.11**.
2.  Download the latest **ence-size** JAR file.
3.  Place the downloaded JAR in your Minecraft `mods/` directory.
4.  *(Recommended)* Install [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) to access the configuration screen directly from the main menu.
